description:
Running work uses the full preview width for a lone agent name. The test seeded a conversation at /c/rw-lone; the browser is told (through a rewritten conversation list, with live updates cut off) that it has one working subagent, "background-worker-alpha". "The preview" is the ".running-work-name" inside [data-testid="running-work-toggle"].
1. Navigate to /c/rw-lone.
2. The preview should have exactly the text "background-worker-alpha".
3. The preview's scrollWidth - clientWidth should become at most 1 (the name is not cut short).
4. The preview's scrollWidth must be greater than half the clientWidth of its closest ".running-work-summary" (it uses the width it has).

steps.expression: (() => { const name = document.querySelector('[data-testid="running-work-toggle"] .running-work-name'); const summary = name.closest('.running-work-summary'); return name.scrollWidth > summary.clientWidth / 2; })()
